item.description: I really like this book - an excellent entrypoint for QM
item.content:encoded: At one point (i.e. on the train to Mohali, for IICM 2023) I decided to write down notes from Shankar’s extensive mathematical prerequisite chapter that prefaces Principles of Quantum Mechanics. You can find it here - Notes.
